div: Solana Devnet Technical docs for plant tokens & $GROWTOO — no monetary value. Risks
p: How growtoo links a journal plant to an optional Solana Devnet plant token: standards, growth rewards, marketplace hold/settle, and planned redemption.
p2: Who this is for: builders and curious adopters who want the plumbing. Regular growers can stay in the journal — you do not need this page to log watering. Prefer the honest product limits? Start with Risks & scope.
p3: Each physical seed you choose to tokenise is represented by a plant token (a Metaplex NFT in the verified growtoo Seeds collection). The NFT is the on-chain record; the public grow journal is the off-chain evidence trail. They link both ways: metadata references the journal plant ID, and the app shows mint address and transactions for each token.
li7: App (growto.live/app) — Firebase-authenticated grow journal. Optional Solana wallet (extension or watch-only) linked by a signed message.
li8: Plant tokens — one per minted seed; strain, batch, and linked plant ID live in metadata (often Arweave via Irys).
li9: $GROWTOO — fungible SPL reward token (9 decimals). Minted as plants advance stages; used as marketplace currency on Devnet.
li10: Mint queue — mint/settlement requests in Firestore; an authority worker executes them on Devnet. Stand-in for future on-chain programs.
p4: On Devnet, one collection authority also controls metadata updates, $GROWTOO minting, and marketplace hold/release. Stage updates only run after matching journal progress exists. Mainnet aims to replace the queue with an on-chain escrow program and stronger attestations — see Risks.
p5: Metaplex Token Metadata, extended with a machine-readable rwa block. Schema reference (legacy path may still use the older filename): seed-rwa.schema.json.
p6: Metadata URI updates each growth stage; rwa.assetType flips from seed to flower at flowering so marketplace listings can distinguish them.
td6: Per stage: Germination 10, Seedling 20, Vegetative 35, Flowering 60, Harvest 100
td8: Devnet marketplace currency; future redemption & governance (planned)
li11: Document growth in the journal and advance the plant token a stage in the app.
li12: The app files a growth-mint request for that mint address.
li13: The worker uploads stage metadata and updates the NFT metadata URI on-chain.
li14: The worker mints that stage’s $GROWTOO reward to the holder’s wallet.
li15: The app shows real transaction signatures (e.g. Solscan) in token history.
li16: List: seller moves the NFT into a marketplace hold; listing goes live with a $GROWTOO ask.
li17: Invest: buyer pays $GROWTOO (instant sale or adopt-stake split).
li18: Settle: payment is confirmed; the plant token is released to the buyer. Sellers can cancel live listings.
p7: Instant sale pays the full ask on buy. Adopt stake locks half until monthly care qualifies at harvest (all-or-nothing). Devnet settlement is operator-assisted; mainnet targets a fully on-chain program.
p8: Redemption would convert the on-chain asset into its real-world counterpart (harvest share), subject to regulation. Still mock / planned — not live fulfillment.
li19: Harvest-stage holder requests redemption in the app (planned).
li20: NFT is burned or marked redeemed.
li21: Operator records physical fulfilment against the batch and journal.
li22: $GROWTOO already earned stays with the holder; only the asset NFT is retired.
p9: After deploy, addresses live in the repository chain/deployed.devnet.json and the app chain config. Devnet only — no monetary value.
p10: Risks & scope · Privacy · Terms · Back to growtoo
p11: Technical reference for the Devnet MVP. Not investment advice. Tokens have no monetary value.
